| **2010s** | *Chris Paul* (2011‑2017), *Blake Griffin* (2013‑2019), *DeAndre Jordan* (2010‑2018), *Kawhi Leonard* (2011‑2012), *Paul George* (2013‑2015), *Reggie Jackson* (2014‑2015) |
| **Recent Years (2018‑present)** | *Paul George* (2019‑2023), *Kawhi Leonard* (2023‑present), *Russell Westbrook* (2021‑2022), *Anthony Davis* (2023‑present), *Julius Randle* (2023‑present), *Kyrie Irving* (2023‑present) |
